title: GridPulse event envelope v1
description: Fields common to every GridPulse event. Per-type schemas extend this with a const event_type and a typed payload.

event_id.description: UUIDv5 over '{source}|{event_type}|{series}|{region}|{valid_from}|{issued_at or empty}' in the GridPulse namespace (ADR-0004).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema this event was written with. Major version is fixed by the folder (v1).

series.description: Distinguishes multiple series of one event type from one source, e.g. 'indo' vs 'itsdo', or a weather location id.

settlement_date.description: UK settlement date (local calendar date). Null for data not aligned to settlement periods, e.g. hourly weather.

settlement_period.description: 1-based half-hour within the settlement date: 48 on normal days, 46 when clocks go forward, 50 when they go back.

issued_at.description: When a forecast was issued. Null for actuals/observations. Part of the event identity, so each forecast revision is kept.

ingested_at.description: When GridPulse fetched the record. Not part of the identity.

utcTimestamp.description: Canonical UTC instant, second precision, 'Z' suffix. Canonical so every language derives identical event_ids.

region.description: 'GB' for national data, otherwise a Carbon Intensity API region (DNO areas and nations), as a stable slug. Also the Kafka partition key.
